description:
Ghostface is back in the upcoming Scream 7, alongside new nightmares like The Mummy (2026) and Whistle (2025) — but why do we love being scared? From the satire of Scary Movie to the chilling classics like Psycho, It, and Hereditary, horror movies mess with our minds in ways most people don’t even realize. Could there be something deeper—something happening inside our brains—that explains our obsession with fear? In this video, we explore the hidden psychology and the rising science of neuro-cinema to uncover what really keeps us coming back for more.
